title: Closed Since Ninety-Eight
summary: Two reflections leave a house of mirrors in the wrong car. The radio is a station that signed off in 1998. Harmony is always one bar late.
visualArc: Tuner parked on 1998 → wrong lot arm-in-arm → rearview singing last bar → ten and two → dead studio furniture → taillights, passenger late.

segments.label: Tuner, 1998
segments.onScreen: Radio needle on a dead frequency; visor card 1998; rain.
segments.lyrics: This is not a sign-off. / This is a station that already left. / Closed since ninety-eight.
segments.musicCue: 84 BPM carrier bed; no live-station hunt
segments.grokImaginePrompt: Macro of a car radio tuner needle parked on a dead frequency, dashboard green glow, a tiny station ID card in the visor reading 1998, night windshield rain, photoreal, Grok Imagine style
segments.geminiOmniPrompt: 12-second macro. Needle does not hunt. Photoreal.

segments.label: Wrong-reflection lot
segments.onScreen: Two women arm in arm; puddle faces do not quite match.
segments.lyrics: We walked out arm in arm / I thought it was you / The glass had opinions
segments.musicCue: Live line; harmony one bar late
segments.grokImaginePrompt: Two nearly identical women in black lace walking arm in arm across a wet night parking lot away from a house of mirrors, their faces in the puddles do not quite match the women walking, cinematic, Grok Imagine style

segments.label: Rearview last bar
segments.onScreen: Rearview mouth on last bar's words; driver on this bar.
segments.lyrics: Closed since ninety-eight / Third passenger, no body / If you sing along you are late
segments.grokImaginePrompt: Interior car at night, rearview mirror showing a mouth singing last bar's words while the driver sings this bar, dashboard glow, empty wet lot through the windshield, photoreal, Grok Imagine style

segments.label: Ten and two
segments.onScreen: Gloved hands; two windshield reflections out of register.
segments.lyrics: Your mouth in the rearview / Is doing last year's sentence / I keep my hands at ten and two
segments.grokImaginePrompt: Close on gloved hands at ten and two on a steering wheel, two reflections in the dark windshield slightly out of register, radio glow, nocturnal, Grok Imagine style

segments.label: Dead studio furniture
segments.onScreen: 1990s radio studio; ON AIR dark; carts still threaded.
segments.lyrics: I don't take requests. / I don't take the present tense. / We are still ninety-eight.
segments.grokImaginePrompt: Empty 1990s radio studio at night, cart machines still threaded, ON AIR lamp dark, no people, dust, the feeling the furniture is still broadcasting, cinematic, Grok Imagine style

segments.label: Keep driving, late
segments.onScreen: Taillights; passenger head turns a beat late.
segments.lyrics: Don't correct the reflection / Don't correct the year / Keep driving
segments.musicCue: Final chorus; harmony still one bar behind
segments.grokImaginePrompt: Taillights on a wet empty road, two silhouettes in the front seats, the passenger's head turns a beat late, rain, no other cars, photoreal, Grok Imagine style
